examples.zh: 加点牛奶。

definitions_en: n. the products of human creativity; works of art collectively
n. the creation of beautiful or significant things
n. a superior skill that you can learn by study and practice and observation

examples.en: Who buys this type of art?
examples.zh: 谁买这种艺术品？

examples.en: Her garden is a work of art.
examples.zh: 她的花园是一件艺术作品。

definitions_en: n. the waging of armed conflict against an enemy
n. a legal state created by a declaration of war and ended by official declaration during which the international rules of war apply
n. an active struggle between competing entities
n. a concerted campaign to end something that is injurious
translations_zh: n. 战争, 战争状态, 战术, 军事, 冲突, 斗争, 竞争
vi. 进行战争, 作战, 打仗, 战斗

examples.zh: 100万人在战争中失去了生命。

examples.zh: 雖然冷戰已經過了這麼多年，俄羅斯人和德國人之間的仇恨還是沒有消除，在蘇聯曾經侵佔過的地區，這種仇恨就更深了。

definitions_en: n. the aggregate of past events
n. a record or narrative description of past events
n. the discipline that records and interprets past events involving human beings
n. the continuum of events occurring in succession leading from the past to the present and even into the future
translations_zh: n. 历史, 过去, 经历, 发展过程, 历史学, 过去的事, 历史记录
[计] 历史记录

examples.zh: 你為什麼知道這麼多的日本歷史?

examples.en: I'm looking for books on Roman history.
examples.zh: 我在找关于古罗马历史的书。

definitions_en: r on the inside
translations_zh: n. 内部, 里头
adv. 在内部, 在内心里
prep. 在...之内

examples.en: The school is located within five minutes' walk of the station.
examples.zh: 學校坐落於距離車站步行五分鐘的地方。

examples.en: I live within walking distance of school.
examples.zh: 我學校離我家只是幾步路的路程。

definitions_en: n. something that results
v. issue or terminate (in a specified way, state, etc.); end
v. come about or follow as a consequence
translations_zh: n. 结果, 成绩, 答案
vi. 产生, 结果, 致使
[计] 结果

examples.en: You are responsible for the result.
examples.zh: 你要对结果负责。

examples.en: One of the great superstitions about education is that learning is the result of teaching.
examples.zh: 很多人覺得有教才有學，但其實這個觀念是錯的。

definitions_en: n. a victory (as in a race or other competition)
v. be the winner in a contest or competition; be victorious
translations_zh: vt. 赢得, 打胜, 成功
vi. 获胜, 达到, 影响
n. 胜利, 赢, 收益

examples.en: At last, Mario managed to win the princess's love.
examples.zh: 最後，馬里奧設法贏得公主的愛。

examples.en: Everyone hoped that she would win.
examples.zh: 每個人都希望她會獲勝。

definitions_en: n. systematic investigation to establish facts
v. attempt to find out in a systematically and scientific manner
v. inquire into
translations_zh: n. 研究, 调查, 考察
vi. 研究, 调查

examples.en: If we knew what we were doing, it wouldn't be called research, would it?
examples.zh: 如果我们知道我们在做什么，那么这不能称之为研究，是吗？

examples.en: The results of the research were quite satisfactory.
examples.zh: 調查的結果十分令人滿意。

definitions_en: n. an informal term for a youth or man
n. an effigy of Guy Fawkes that is burned on a bonfire on Guy Fawkes Day
n. a cable, wire, or rope that is used to brace something (especially a tent)
v. steady or support with a guy wire or cable
translations_zh: n. 家伙, 支索
vt. 用支索撑住, 取笑, 嘲弄
vi. 逃跑

examples.en: After a couple of drinks, the guy was feeling no pain.
examples.zh: 喝了幾杯酒後，這個傢伙就感覺不痛了。

examples.en: I think you're a really nice guy.
examples.zh: 我認為你真的是一個好人。

definitions_en: n. a powerful effect or influence
n. (physics) the influence that produces a change in a physical quantity
n. physical energy or intensity
n. group of people willing to obey orders
translations_zh: n. 力量, 武力, 势力, 影响力, 军队, 力, 效力
vt. 强迫, 强夺, 推动, 提高
[计] 人工转移; 强制

examples.en: I will never force you to marry him.
examples.zh: 我永遠不會逼你跟他結婚。

examples.en: I went into the air force.
examples.zh: 我加入了空軍。

definitions_en: n. the verbal act of offering
n. something offered (as a proposal or bid)
v. make available or accessible, provide or furnish
v. present for acceptance or rejection
translations_zh: n. 给予(物), 出价, 提议, 意图, 报价
vt. 提供, 出价, 奉献, 试图, 使出现, 演出

examples.en: You should have refused his offer.
examples.zh: 你應該拒絕他的提議的。

examples.en: It was foolish of you to accept his offer.
examples.zh: 你真笨去接受他的提議。

definitions_en: n. the activities of educating or instructing; activities that impart knowledge or skill
n. knowledge acquired by learning and instruction
n. the gradual process of acquiring knowledge
n. the profession of teaching (especially at a school or college or university)

[医] 教育, 训练

examples.zh: 世界上的教育都讓我失望。

examples.en: If you think education is expensive, wait till you see what ignorance costs you.
examples.zh: 如果你認為教育是昂貴的, 那麼你等著看無知讓你付出的代價。

definitions_en: conj. Grant all this; be it that; supposing that;
notwithstanding; though.
translations_zh: conj. 虽然, 尽管

examples.en: Although her house is nearby, I seldom see her.
examples.zh: 雖然我住在她家附近，可是也很少見到她。

examples.en: Although Hiroko dislikes cigarette smoke, she readily goes out drinking with friends.
examples.zh: 虽然弘子不喜欢香烟的烟雾，她却乐意和朋友出去喝酒。

definitions_en: prep. Alt. of Towards
adv. Alt. of Towards
prep. Approaching; coming near.
prep. Readly to do or learn; compliant with duty; not froward;
apt; docile; tractable; as, a toward youth.
prep. Ready to act; forward; bold; valiant.
translations_zh: prep. 向, 对于, 为了
a. 即将来临的, 进行中的

examples.en: Our plans are to advance toward the city.
examples.zh: 我們的計劃是向都市前進。

examples.en: Hundreds of buffaloes moved toward the lake.
examples.zh: 數以百計的水牛走向湖邊。

definitions_en: n. a plan of action adopted by an individual or social group
n. a line of argument rationalizing the course of action of a government
n. written contract or certificate of insurance
translations_zh: n. 政策, 方针, 策略, 保险单
[医] 凭单, 保险单

examples.en: This measure is in accord with our policy.
examples.zh: 這個議案合符我們的政策內容。

examples.en: Honesty is not always the best policy.
examples.zh: 誠實不總是最好的策略。

definitions_en: n. (psychology) the performance of some composite cognitive activity; an operation that affects mental contents
n. a mental process that you are not directly aware of
n. a natural prolongation or projection from a part of an organism either animal or plant
n. a sustained phenomenon or one marked by gradual changes through a series of states
translations_zh: n. 程序, 进行, 过程
vt. 加工, 使...接受处理, 对...处置, 对...起诉
a. 经加工的, 有特殊光效的
[计] 进程

examples.en: I explained the process to him.
examples.zh: 我向他解釋了這個過程。

examples.en: This process has a lot of inconveniences.
examples.zh: 这个程序缺陷满多。

definitions_en: v. take into consideration for exemplifying purposes
v. show consideration for; take into account
v. think about carefully; weigh
v. regard or treat with consideration, respect, and esteem
translations_zh: v. 考虑, 思考, 认为

examples.en: You must consider what kind of work you want to do.
examples.zh: 你一定要考慮清楚你想做怎麼樣的工作。

examples.en: The Japanese at large consider themselves better off than they used to be.
examples.zh: 日本人一般都覺得自己的生活比以前過得好。

definitions_en: v. come into sight or view
v. be issued or published
v. seem to be true, probable, or apparent
v. come into being or existence, or appear on the scene
translations_zh: vi. 出现, 显得, 来到
[法] 出庭, 到案, 出现

examples.en: Speak of the devil and he is sure to appear.
examples.zh: 说曹操，曹操就到。

examples.en: Kelly will appear on TV.
examples.zh: 凱莉將在電視上出現。

r. used to imply that one would expect the fact to be the opposite of that stated; surprisingly
r. at the present moment
r. as a sentence modifier to add slight emphasis
translations_zh: adv. 事实上, 竟然, 如今, 现在

examples.zh: 即使你的句子实际上是毫无意义的，至少你有幸能造出好句子。

examples.en: Did you actually see the accident?
examples.zh: 你真的看到了這起事故嗎？

translations_zh: adv. 大概, 或许

examples.zh: 這首詩是不是莎士比亞寫的，恐怕是無從考究的了。

examples.en: Dinner is probably ready, so we had better hurry home.
examples.zh: 晚飯大概已經準備好了，我們還是快點回家吧。

definitions_en: a. characteristic of humanity
a. relating to a person
a. having human form or attributes as opposed to those of animals or divine beings

examples.zh: 人皆有錯，唯聖者能恕。

examples.zh: 豬與人類的一些特性相同。

definitions_en: n. a general conscious awareness

n. the faculty through which the external world is apprehended
n. a natural appreciation or ability

examples.zh: 某些失明者会产生一个弥补性的能力，这个能力让他们察觉到他们与离他们很近的物体的距离。

examples.zh: 每個國家都應該彼此幫助。

examples.zh: 总统在电视上对国民讲话。

examples.zh: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。

examples.zh: 现在的贷款利率很高。

examples.zh: 我们对他的死亡表示遗憾。

examples.zh: 我们常把黑色跟死亡联系起来。

translations_zh: n. 课程, 路线, 过程, 一道菜, 道路
v. 追, (使)跑

examples.zh: 当然我接受了他的支援请求。

examples.zh: 当然是的。

examples.zh: 如果你是第一次到外國生活的話，加拿大會很適合你。

examples.zh: 我打了電話給你，但卻接不通。

examples.zh: 近几年，很多当地的传统都衰败了。

vi. 杀死
[计] 删除

examples.zh: 我会不高兴，但我不会自杀。

examples.zh: 我试着消磨时间。

examples.zh: 我不可能繼續保持沈默了。

examples.en: Whether Shakespeare wrote this poem or not will probably remain a mystery.
examples.zh: 這首詩是不是莎士比亞寫的，恐怕是無從考究的了。

[计] 效果

examples.zh: 環境污染可以對一個區域的生態造成極大的影響。

examples.en: It has had no effect on him.
examples.zh: 这对他没有影响。

n. (physiology) regulation or maintenance of a function or action or reflex etc
n. the activity of managing or exerting control over something

vt. 控制, 操纵, 抑制
[计] 控制; 控制器

examples.en: You must control yourself.
examples.zh: 你必須控制自己。

examples.en: When it comes to sweets, I just can't control myself.
examples.zh: 一看到甜点，我就无法自拔。

definitions_en: r by chance
translations_zh: adv. 也许, 大概

examples.zh: 也許你說得對。我一直都很自私。

examples.zh: 甚至在這些國家以外，英語也許比其他任何語言更廣泛地被使用來當作國際交流的媒介。

s. (used especially of persons) of the immediate past

n. 起形成作用的人(或物), 模型, 样板

examples.zh: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。

examples.zh: 我遇見了以前的班主任時，他問候了我的父母。

n. a university student who is studying a particular field as the principal subject
n. the principal field of study of a student at a university

vi. 主修

examples.zh: 你专攻什么领域？

examples.zh: 据一些学者称，现在可能随时发生一场特大地震。

v make someone do something
v have need of
translations_zh: vt. 需要, 命令, 要求
[法] 需要, 要求, 命令

examples.zh: 現代戰術並無指明士兵必須全副武裝上陣才能發揮其最大的戰鬥力。

examples.en: We require your help.
examples.zh: 我們需要你的幫助。

translations_zh: n. 角色, 职责, 任务

examples.zh: 无论我们是否喜欢电脑，它在我们的生活中始终起着重要的作用。

examples.zh: 女性永遠只能扮演次要角色嗎？

s. using the minimum of time or resources necessary for effectiveness
s. concerned with worldly necessities of life (especially money)
translations_zh: a. 经济上的, 实用的, 节省的
[经] 经济的

examples.zh: 更多投資在教育的錢將會刺激經濟成長。

examples.zh: 日本正面臨著嚴重的經濟問題。

definitions_en: n. use of physical or mental energy; hard work
translations_zh: n. 努力, 成就

examples.zh: 没有什么是不劳而获的。

examples.zh: 你應該努力去戒煙。

vi. 被评价, 责骂

examples.zh: 按照这个速度，我们不会在这周结束前完成。

examples.zh: 随着通货膨胀的发展美元贬值了。

v. use recreational drugs
translations_zh: n. 药, 麻药, 麻醉药

vt. 使服麻醉药, 使麻木

examples.zh: 毒品是国际性的问题。

examples.zh: 股票價格跌至歷史新低。

examples.zh: 股價下跌了。

definitions_en: n. the particular occupation for which you are trained
n. the general progression of your working or professional life

examples.zh: 她似乎把自己所有的精力都投入到了事业上。

examples.zh: 她想去北京发展她的事业。

prep. 虽然, 尽管

n. the management of someone or something
n. a manner of dealing with something artistically

examples.zh: 我不習慣這樣的待遇。

r. in addition

adv. 在远处

examples.zh: 你看過富士山嗎? 它美得無法形容。

r just as it should be
r in a precise manner

examples.zh: 我們的飛機準時在六時正起飛了。

definitions_en: n. ideas or actions intended to deal with a problem or situation

examples.zh: 据一些学者称，现在可能随时发生一场特大地震。

definitions_en: n a means or instrumentality for storing or communicating information

examples.zh: 某些失明者会产生一个弥补性的能力，这个能力让他们察觉到他们与离他们很近的物体的距离。

examples.zh: 在全体职员回家后，火事爆发了。

definitions_en: n. an interconnected system of things or people

examples.zh: 英國必須改善它在鐵路網的問題。

examples.zh: 怎么用路由器限制网速？

definitions_en: a. established by or founded upon law or official or accepted rules

examples.zh: 你的行为完全合法。

examples.zh: 美國的司法制度是世界上最好的。

definitions_en: n. a member of a religious order who is bound by vows of poverty and chastity and obedience

examples.zh: 我是一個虔誠的教徒，我相信死後的生命。

examples.zh: 想要跟你分享他们宗教信仰的人几乎从不愿你跟他们分享你的。

definitions_en: n. a mild viral infection involving the nose and respiratory passages (but not the lungs)
n. the sensation produced by low temperatures
a. having a low or inadequate temperature or feeling a sensation of coldness or having been made cold by e.g. ice or refrigeration
a. extended meanings; especially of psychological coldness; without human warmth or emotion

adv. 完全地

examples.zh: 雖然冷戰已經過了這麼多年，俄羅斯人和德國人之間的仇恨還是沒有消除，在蘇聯曾經侵佔過的地區，這種仇恨就更深了。

examples.en: the coldness made our breath visible

definitions_en: n. the final match between the winners of all previous matches in an elimination tournament

examples.zh: 我們讓他做最後的決定。

examples.en: My final destination in China is the city of Harbin in the north-east, about one thousand kilometres from Beijing.
examples.zh: 我在中国最后的目的地是东北的哈尔滨，离北京大概一千公里左右。

examples.zh: 他主要的人生目標就是成為一個有錢人。

examples.zh: 他们主要输出的产品是纺织品，尤其以丝绸和绵为主。

definitions_en: n. something that is remembered

n. 内存

examples.en: I wish I had a better memory.

examples.zh: 这个团体内的每个人，像是一个健康的人体内免疫系统里的细胞。

examples.en: Can you give me your cell number?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我你的手机号吗？

definitions_en: v. set up or found

examples.zh: 仪式以他的讲话开始。

s. reduced to the simplest and most significant form possible without loss of generality

examples.en: At one time, people would not have hesitated to light up a cigarette in stations, restaurants, or hospital waiting rooms.

definitions_en: n. preceding in time
translations_zh: n. 优先权, 优先
[计] 优先级

examples.en: Camera quality is a top priority for me.
examples.zh: 相機品質是我的優先考量。

examples.en: ...its precedence as the world's leading manufacturer of pharmaceuticals

definitions_en: n. a measuring instrument for measuring fluid volume; a glass container (cup or cylinder or flask) whose sides are marked with or divided into amounts
v. receive an academic degree upon completion of one's studies
v. confer an academic degree upon
s. of or relating to studies beyond a bachelor's degree
translations_zh: n. 毕业生, 量杯
a. 已得学位的, 研究生的, 毕业的
vi. 毕业, 得学位, 逐渐变为
vt. 准予...毕业, 授予...学位, 分等级, 刻刻度

examples.en: When did you graduate from Oxford?
examples.zh: 你什麼時候從牛津大學畢業的？

examples.en: When did you graduate from high school?
examples.zh: 你什麼時候中學畢業?

definitions_en: n. a formal message requesting something that is submitted to an authority
n. the verbal act of requesting
v. express the need or desire for; ask for
v. ask (a person) to do something
translations_zh: n. 请求, 需要, 申请书
vt. 请求, 要求, 邀请
[计] 请求

examples.en: You should have refused his request flatly.
examples.zh: 你应该直接拒绝他的要求。

examples.en: Under the circumstances I cannot allow the request.
examples.zh: 在這種情況之下,我不能允許這個要求。

definitions_en: n. any strong feeling
translations_zh: n. 情绪, 激动, 强烈的情感
[医] 情绪, 情感

examples.en: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
examples.zh: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。

definitions_en: n. sharp piercing cry
v. make a loud, piercing sound
translations_zh: n. 尖叫声
vi. 尖叫, 大笑, 尖啸, 令人震惊
vt. 尖叫着说, 大叫大嚷着要求

examples.en: I heard someone scream.
examples.zh: 我听到尖叫声。

examples.en: Scream it loud!
examples.zh: 大声喊!

definitions_en: a. suitable to or characteristic of drama
s. sensational in appearance or thrilling in effect
a. pertaining to or characteristic of drama
a. used of a singer or singing voice that is marked by power and expressiveness and a histrionic or theatrical style
translations_zh: a. 戏剧性的, 生动的

examples.en: a dramatic entrance in a swirling cape
a dramatic rescue at sea

definitions_en: n. everything that exists anywhere
n. everything stated or assumed in a given discussion

examples.en: Mathematics is the part of science you could continue to do if you woke up tomorrow and discovered the universe was gone.
examples.zh: 就算你明天起床，發現整個宇宙消失了，還有一門科學是可以繼續研究的 ﹣ 那就是數學了。

examples.en: Any universe simple enough to be understood is too simple to produce a mind able to understand it.
examples.zh: 任何簡單到可以被了解的宇宙便太過簡單而無法產生可以了解它的心靈。

definitions_en: n. a conspicuous disparity or difference as between two figures
n. a narrow opening
n. a difference (especially an unfortunate difference) between two opinions or two views or two situations
v. make an opening or gap in
translations_zh: n. 缝隙, 缺口, 间断, 间距, 通用汇编程序
vt. 打开缺口, 造成缝隙
vi. 豁开
[计] 通用汇编程序, 图形应用程序, 间距

examples.en: The gap between them has narrowed.
examples.zh: 两人之间的距离已拉近。

examples.en: Please mind the gap between the train and the platform.
examples.zh: 請小心月台與車廂之間的空隙。

definitions_en: s. very good; of the highest quality
translations_zh: a. 优良的, 杰出的, 出色的

examples.en: Martha is an excellent pianist.
examples.zh: 瑪莎是一位優秀的鋼琴家。

examples.en: Tom's speech was excellent.
examples.zh: 湯姆的演講非常好。

definitions_en: s. occurring by chance
a. having or bringing good fortune
translations_zh: a. 幸运的, 吉祥的, 好运的, 侥幸的

examples.en: It was lucky for you that you found it.
examples.zh: 你很幸運找到了它。

examples.en: But he was lucky.
examples.zh: 但是他很幸運。

definitions_en: n. the phenomenon of resistance to motion through a fluid
n. something that slows or delays progress
n. something tedious and boring
n. clothing that is conventionally worn by the opposite sex (especially women's clothing when worn by a man)
translations_zh: n. 拖, 拖累
v. 拖累, 拖拉, 沉重缓慢地走, 拖动
[计] 拖动

examples.en: The stage charisma of drag performers compels audiences to reconsider their own stereotypes.
examples.zh: 反串秀者的舞台魅力使觀眾不禁重新審視自己的刻板印象。

examples.en: the drag up the hill exhausted him

definitions_en: n. a hose that carries air under pressure
n. a commercial enterprise that provides scheduled flights for passengers
translations_zh: n. 航线, 航线的设备, 航空公司

examples.en: How is this airline?
examples.zh: 這個航空公司的飛機怎麼樣？

definitions_en: v. get or find back; recover the use of
v. regain a former condition after a financial loss
v. regain or make up for
v. cover anew
translations_zh: vt. 重新获得, 恢复, 复原, 拯救
vi. 痊愈, 复原, 胜诉
[计] 恢复

examples.en: Will it take long to recover?
examples.zh: 要很長的時間才能恢復嗎？

examples.en: The patient is recuperating

definitions_en: n. an assortment of things from which a choice can be made
translations_zh: n. 选择, 选文, 精选品
[医] 选择, 淘汰

examples.en: My mother prefers the arbitrary selection of the lottery machines over my lucky numbers.
examples.zh: 我母亲宁愿选彩票机上的任意数字，也不选我的幸运数字。

examples.en: your choice of colors was unfortunate

definitions_en: r. of primary import
translations_zh: adv. 主要地, 首先地

examples.en: If economic globalization is inevitable, it should primarily serve humanity rather than the interests of trans-national corporations.
examples.zh: 如果全球化无法避免，应该首先为人服务而不是为跨国公司的利益服务。

examples.en: The economist and statistician based in Ivory Coast says commercial trade in the region is primarily conducted with France.
examples.zh: 這位常駐科特迪瓦的經濟學家兼統計學家表示，該地區的商業貿易主要與法國進行。

definitions_en: n. a protective covering that covers or forms the top of a building
n. protective covering on top of a motor vehicle
n. the inner top surface of a covered area or hollow space
v. provide a building with a roof; cover a building with a roof
translations_zh: n. 屋顶, 室顶
vt. 给...盖屋顶, 遮蔽

examples.en: The roof was damaged by the storm.
examples.zh: 屋頂被暴風雨損壞了。

examples.en: Look at the house with the red roof.
examples.zh: 看看那間紅色屋頂的房子。

definitions_en: a. (usually followed by `to') not having the necessary means or skill or know-how
s. (usually followed by `to') lacking necessary physical or mental ability
translations_zh: a. 不能的, 不会的
[法] 无能力的, 无资格的, 没有办法的

examples.zh: 我打了電話給你，但卻接不通。

examples.en: In the end, because of the disease, he became unable to walk and had to use a motorized wheelchair to get around.
examples.zh: 最後，他的病奪去了他走路的能力，想去哪兒也要用電動輪椅來代步。

definitions_en: n. amounts paid for goods and services that may be currently tax deductible (as opposed to capital expenditures)

v. reduce the estimated value of something

[经] 费用, 开支, 将支出转为费用

examples.en: The total expense for the project amounts to one hundred million yen.
examples.zh: 計劃的總開支為一億円。

examples.en: John finished the work at the expense of his health.
examples.zh: 約翰犧牲自己的健康，完成工作。

definitions_en: n readiness to embark on bold new ventures
n the first of a series of actions
s serving to set in motion
translations_zh: n. 主动行动, 首创精神, 主动权
a. 自发的, 起始的

examples.en: He takes the initiative in helping his mother do the housework.
examples.zh: 他主动帮他妈妈做家务。

examples.en: The initiative measurably improved quality of life for the villagers.
examples.zh: 計劃使村民的生活改善了不少。

definitions_en: n. a prescribed selection of foods
n. a legislative assembly in certain countries (e.g., Japan)
n. the usual food and drink consumed by an organism (person or animal)
n. the act of restricting your food intake (or your intake of particular foods)

vt. 照规定饮食
vi. 忌食

examples.en: We're going to eat a lot tonight so I hope you're not on a diet.
examples.zh: 我们今晚会吃很多，所以我希望你没有在节食。

examples.en: I think you'd better go on a diet.
examples.zh: 我想你應該節食了。

definitions_en: n. the state of inactivity following an interruption

vt. 拘捕, 抑制, 吸引, 阻止

examples.zh: 为什么警察不逮捕Tom？

examples.en: Did the police arrest Tom?
examples.zh: 警察逮捕了湯姆嗎？

definitions_en: n. an ordered list of times at which things are planned to occur
v. plan for an activity or event

translations_zh: n. 时间表, 一览表, 计划表, 议事日程
vt. 预定, 编制目录, 制...表, 安排

examples.en: We should have taken the schedule into consideration.
examples.zh: 我们本该考虑一下行程。

examples.en: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
examples.zh: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

definitions_en: n. a document stating the facts and points of law of a client's case
n. a condensed written summary or abstract
v. give essential information to someone
s. of short duration or distance
translations_zh: n. 摘要, 简报
a. 简短的, 短暂的
vt. 对...作简报, 摘要, 节录

examples.zh: 他简单地阐述了他的理由。

definitions_en: n. the acquisition of something for payment

vt. 购买, 赢得, 努力取得, 用滑轮起(锚等)

examples.zh: 我想买些靴子。

examples.en: To purchase a ticket, you need to enter your personal details.
examples.zh: 你要先輸入好個人資料，然後才能買票。

definitions_en: n. an alloy of iron with small amounts of carbon; widely used in construction; mechanical properties can be varied over a wide range
n. knife sharpener consisting of a ridged steel rod
v. get ready for something difficult or unpleasant
v. cover, plate, or edge with steel
translations_zh: n. 钢, 钢制品, 钢铁, 坚硬, 坚固
a. 钢的, 钢制的, 钢铁业的, 坚强的
vt. 使坚强, 钢化, 使冷酷

examples.zh: 今個月的鋼鐵產量和上個月比起來，估計會上升兩個巴仙。

examples.zh: 一項估計顯示，今年的鋼鉄產量將會達到一億噸。

v look at attentively
v connect closely and often incriminatingly
translations_zh: prep. 关于

examples.zh: 在这点上他泄露了秘密。

examples.en: Regarding the question at hand, can I give you an answer in two days' time?
examples.zh: 关于该问题的答复，我两天后再回答你可以吗？

definitions_en: a relating to or using sight
s visible; give me the ocular proof"- Shakespeare
translations_zh: a. 视觉的
[医] 视觉的, 视力的, 视觉性记忆优势者

examples.en: be sure of it; give me the ocular proof
a visual presentation

definitions_en: r. without favoring one party, in a fair evenhanded manner
r. in conformity with the rules or laws and without fraud or cheating
translations_zh: adv. 美观地, 公平地, 相当地, 清楚地

examples.zh: 这方案听起来不错。

examples.en: The surface of the object is fairly rough.
examples.zh: 這件物件的表面頗為粗糙。

examples.zh: 她现在很暴力。最好避着点。

examples.zh: 进一步的检查发现头骨受到剧烈的撞击而碎裂。

examples.zh: 学生在课堂上必须保持安静。

examples.zh: 因為不知道該說什麼, 他保持沉默。

definitions_en: v. express a supposition
translations_zh: vt. 推想, 假设, 以为, 想像, 假定
vi. 料想

examples.en: I suppose it's different when you think about it over the long term.
examples.zh: 我认为你考虑久了就会不一样了。

examples.en: I suppose you're hungry.
examples.zh: 我猜想您饿了。

a. (used as a combining form) relating to--of or by or to or from or for--the self
translations_zh: n. 自己, 自我, 本性, 本质, 私心, 本人
vt. 使近亲繁殖, 使自花授精
vi. 自花授精
a. 同一的

examples.en: President Lincoln was what we call a self-made man.
examples.zh: 林肯總統就是我們所謂白手起家的男人。

examples.en: A cafeteria is a self-service style restaurant.

examples.zh: 我从你的表情猜到你有好消息。

n. relation based on similarities and differences
n. qualities that are comparable
translations_zh: n. 比较, 对照, 比喻
[经] 比较, 对比

examples.en: Country life is very peaceful in comparison with city life.
examples.zh: 和都市生活相比，鄉村生活和諧多了。

examples.en: In comparison with Tokyo, London is small.
examples.zh: 和东京比，伦敦很小。

definitions_en: n. a conclusive resolution of a matter and disposition of it

translations_zh: n. 安顿, 解决, 处理, 结算, 殖民, 殖民地, 沉降
[医] 居住区; 沉渣

examples.en: the British colonization of America
they finally reached a settlement with the union

n. thin structure composed of a single thickness of cells

vt. 分层堆积, 压植
[计] 层

examples.zh: 太阳穴钝钝地痛，意识似乎被笼罩上了一层薄薄的雾霭。

examples.zh: 在眼皮上輕輕疊加金色眼影。

n. sort or variety
translations_zh: n. 描述, 说明, 种类
[经] 说明书(物品), 品名种类, 货物名称

examples.en: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
examples.zh: 你看過富士山嗎? 它美得無法形容。

examples.en: The beauty of the scene was beyond description.
examples.zh: 那裏的景色美得無法以筆墨形容。

n. (geology) the descent of a large mass of earth or rocks or snow etc.
n. plaything consisting of a sloping chute down which children can slide
n. the act of moving smoothly along a surface while remaining in contact with it
translations_zh: n. 滑, 滑道, 山崩, 雪崩, 幻灯片
vt. 使滑动, 偷偷放入
vi. 滑动, 滑落, 不知不觉陷入, 偷偷地走

examples.en: Of course he thought it was a joke and let it slide with a "hm?" but he was seriously annoyed. I mean, just don't say things like that even as a joke!
examples.zh: 當然, 他知道這只是個玩笑, 所以他"嗯?" 了一聲一笑置之, 但是他覺得非常厭煩。(我的意思是, 你不要再說這樣的事情了, 即使它只是個玩笑話!）

examples.en: his slide didn't stop until the bottom of the hill

definitions_en: r. to a great degree
r. so as to leave much space or distance between
translations_zh: adv. 广泛地

examples.en: English is by far the most widely-spoken language in the world.
examples.zh: 英語是目前在世界上使用最廣泛的語言。

examples.en: And even outside these nations, English is perhaps more widely used as a medium of international communication than any other language.
examples.zh: 甚至在這些國家以外，英語也許比其他任何語言更廣泛地被使用來當作國際交流的媒介。

definitions_en: n. the social event at which the ceremony of marriage is performed
n. a party of people at a wedding
translations_zh: n. 婚礼, 结婚, 结婚周年纪念日, 结合
[法] 结婚, 婚礼, 结婚纪念日

examples.en: Food and drink were served in such profusion at the wedding that the bride and groom began to wonder if they should not have invited more guests.
examples.zh: 婚礼上饮料和食物那么丰富以至于那对年轻的新人开始怀疑他们本不该邀请更多的客人。

examples.en: Where is the wedding to be?
examples.zh: 婚礼在哪儿举行？

definitions_en: v. impart knowledge of some fact, state or affairs, or event to

v. act as an informer

examples.zh: 如果情况有任何变化，请务必通知我。

examples.en: Please inform me when to start.
examples.zh: 请通知我何时开始。

definitions_en: n something determined in relation to something that includes it

vt. 分配, 给...嫁妆

examples.zh: 他吃完排骨又點了一份。

examples.zh: 你進入了危險區。

examples.zh: 军队占领了整片领土。

examples.zh: 他们需要做决定——即刻作出决定。

examples.zh: 他的演說贏得了觀眾熱烈的掌聲。

a. 敌对的, 反对的, 对面的

examples.zh: 我們這隊5-4擊敗對手。

examples.zh: 他把對手擊倒了。
